QuestInfo.name: The Mind of a Knight: The Finale
QuestInfo.1: This is the opportunity #p1101002# spoke of. Go to #m130000000#.
QuestInfo.2: Your mind is noble, your heart is clear. You have become a true Cygnus Knight.

0.0: #h0#, you may be ready. Come find me in #m130000000#.

yes.0: Superb. I will be waiting for you.

no.0: Perhaps I need to hire you an assistant to better manage your time.

1.0: #h0#, your mind is sharp and your wits are keen. I would think this to be its own reward, but I'm sure you would like something valuable as well.

yes.0: You are the first of our knights to complete the training. I'm sure you'll enjoy the bragging rights for some time.
